title: Design: Work Orders settings show the Internal Work Orders toggle, off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have an organization where Internal Work Orders has never been turned on.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-01-01-settings-work-orders-setting-off.png, iwo-happy-01-01-turn-on-internal-work-orders.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under Workflow, after Require Review Before Completion, a toggle row "Internal Work Orders" (Title Case, bold like the other toggle names) is shown, switched off.
  • Its grey description under the name reads "Lets you flag your own company as an internal customer and mark a customer's work order, or a single line of a billable work order, as No Charge (warranty, goodwill, comeback). Internal and no-charge work orders close without an invoice; their parts cost posts to the expense account of their category instead of Cost of Parts."
  • No hint lines show under the description while the toggle is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R1: “Settings > Work Orders shows a toggle "Internal Work Orders" (Title Case like the other toggles on the tab), off by default, organization-wide like the other toggles, with the description "Lets you flag your own company as an internal customer and mark a customer's work order, or a single line of a billable work order, as No Charge (warranty, goodwill, comeback). Internal and no-charge work orders close without an invoice; their parts cost posts to the expense account of their category instead of Cost of Parts."”
  • S1-R3: “While the toggle is on, two hint lines sit under the description, each with an info icon: "Manage categories in Internal Work Orders (Administration > Service). Their expense accounts are set on each category." where Internal Work Orders is a link to the categories page (S1-R13), and "Map their expense accounts in Integrations > QuickBooks." with the QuickBooks mark, where QuickBooks is a link (shown only when QuickBooks is connected at any location; for AccountingHub the hint names Accounting > Account Mappings; with both, the hint names both; with neither, the second line is omitted).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 0 · Turn it on" / "Happy flow v6", boards "01 Settings · Work Orders, setting off" (Flow 0 · Turn it on), "01 Turn on Internal Work Orders" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow0-01-01-settings-work-orders-setting-off.png
  • iwo-happy-01-01-turn-on-internal-work-orders.png

The design's own words:

  • “Internal Work Orders”
  • “Lets you flag your own company as an internal customer and mark a customer's work order as No Charge (warranty, goodwill, comeback).”

Difference: the design's description is shorter ("...mark a customer's work order as No Charge (warranty, goodwill, comeback). Both close without an invoice..."): register IWO-D01, settled by S1-R1 (the PRD text wins).
